payload.name: Count Owned Instances with Profile Search and Named Follow-up
payload.description: When counting how many of a category an entity owns as of a date and an event-only search returns plans or vague references, search profile/state memories and follow up on any named instances.
content: When counting owned items as of a target date, do not restrict to memory_kinds=['event']; also include 'profile' and 'state' because current ownership is often stored as a profile fact (e.g., 'Andrew has a dog named Toby').

If a returned memory mentions a named instance (e.g., a pet's name) or a plan involving one, run a targeted search for that name with the owner (e.g., '<owner> adopted <name>' or '<owner> <name> pet') across both event and profile memory kinds to confirm whether the acquired instance exists as of the target date.
Stop after each distinct instance is confirmed via an event or profile memory, or after one targeted search per mentioned name yields no new evidence.

solves: Counting owned items (e.g., pets) as of a target date fails when ownership is stored as a profile or state memory rather than an event, or when named instances appear only in plans or other memories and are not followed up with targeted searches, causing the agent to miss instances or count intentions as possessions.
